changes: Added docs/requirements/decisions/stash-split-execution-plan.md and updated docs/requirements/NAV.md. The plan splits stash@{0} into concrete future buckets, forbids whole-stash apply/pop/restore, protects dev-memory data, forbids stale NAV restore, and pins the stash object before executable commands.
usage: Use docs/requirements/decisions/stash-split-execution-plan.md as the execution guide before processing the parked stash. Start one future story per bucket, capture STASH_OBJECT, restore only approved paths, and run the bucket-specific checks before commit.
expectedOutcome: User can open the decision document and see a safe, executable plan for processing stash@{0}, with NAV updated and no stash content applied by this story.
actualTranscript: lattice validate --story=B-8f4c --json returned status pass, allPass true, npm test pass, cli-e2e ALL PASS, and verification intent coverage 9/9. Delivery reviewer verified five document promises and three real-machine tests.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. The story delivered the execution document and NAV entry only; stash bucket execution remains intentionally deferred to future stories.
limitations: This story does not process or drop the stash. It only documents the safe split plan; each bucket still needs its own future story, implementation, tests, and review.
pitfalls: Worktree validation initially failed because node_modules and packages/main/dist were missing in the worktree; symlinked ignored node_modules and ran npm run build to create ignored dist before rerunning validate. Reviewer also caught that positional stash@{0} refs could drift, so the plan now pins STASH_OBJECT.
